researchTarget: XTND post-merger capitalization and liquidity evidence
researchQuestion: Can independent post-close evidence resolve XTND common-share and pre-funded-warrant counts and narrow the remaining dilution/liquidity unknowns without double counting securities?
summary: Independent review resolves the largest point-in-time capitalization unknown from the required underwriting lane. A post-close Schedule 13G states, using issuer-provided information, that 284,842,854 XTND common shares were outstanding as of September 4, 2026. The closing 8-K separately states that 27,544,248 pre-funded warrants were issued in the redomestication. The resulting common-plus-pre-funded common-equivalent layer is 312,387,102 before unexercised legacy/rollover awards, new-plan reserves and contingent earnouts. This differs from the 277,442,600 pro-forma weighted-average denominator and confirms that denominator is not a current outstanding-share count. Liquidity remains only bounded rather than fully resolved: pro-forma unrestricted cash plus PIPE was $99.779M before transaction-cost uses; corroborating H1 2026 evidence reports $34.33M of operating cash use over six months and an undrawn $25M bank facility as of June 30. Historical-burn sensitivity is about 17.4 months on gross pro-forma cash, or about 14.7 months after a conservative subtraction of the $15.52M accrued transaction-cost liability. These are sensitivities, not forecasts.

evidence.fact: 284,842,854 common shares outstanding as of September 4, 2026, based on issuer information reported in a September 10 Schedule 13G.
27,544,248 pre-funded warrants to purchase common stock were issued in the redomestication.
evidence.source: SEC Form 8-K filed September 3, 2026; full-text mirror: https://www.streetinsider.com/SEC%2BFilings/Form%2B8-K12B%2BXtend%2BAI%2BRobotics%2C%2BInc.%2BFor%3A%2BSep%2B03/27024800.html

evidence.fact: Pro-forma weighted-average basic/diluted denominator was 277,442,600; cash and cash equivalents were $39.779M plus a $60M PIPE adjustment; accrued transaction-cost liabilities included about $15.520M.
September 4 S-8 registered 9,936,483 rollover-award shares, 18,630,959 shares under the 2026 Equity Incentive Plan and 15,000,000 shares under the 2026 ESPP.
H1 2026 operating cash use was about $34.33M; June 30 cash was about $34.81M; an amended bank facility provided up to $25M and was undrawn at June 30.
evidence.note: Corroboration only until the underlying primary cash-flow/facility disclosure is attached directly.

findings: Current issued common is bounded at 284,842,854 as of September 4, 2026.
Current common plus pre-funded common-equivalent securities total 312,387,102 based on separate post-close disclosures.
The 277,442,600 pro-forma weighted-average denominator is not the correct point-in-time outstanding-share count.
New-plan reserved capacity under the 2026 Equity Incentive Plan plus ESPP totals 33,630,959 shares; these are reserves, not current issued shares.
Two possible 10M-share earnout tranches remain contingent and should be modeled separately from current outstanding securities.
Historical H1 burn sensitivity against $99.779M gross pro-forma cash is about 17.4 months; subtracting the $15.52M transaction-cost liability as a conservative sensitivity gives about 14.7 months.
contradictions: Pre-close S-4 materials estimated up to 24,873,730 pre-funded warrants, while the closing 8-K reports 27,544,248 actually issued; closing evidence should govern post-close counts.
The 277.4M pro-forma denominator is below issuer-provided post-close common outstanding of 284.8M, proving they are different accounting constructs.
unknowns: Exact legacy/rollover option count that is incremental to the 312,387,102 common-plus-pre-funded layer.
Whether any pre-funded warrants were exercised after September 4, 2026.
Post-close operating cash burn, capex, working-capital demand and transaction-cost cash payments.
Exact post-merger draw status and covenant headroom of the bank facility.
Probability of the two revenue-linked earnout tranches.
falsifiers: A later issuer filing that restates the September 4 common-share count.
Closing evidence showing the 27,544,248 pre-funded-warrant underlying shares were already included in the 284,842,854 common outstanding.
Primary post-close cash-flow evidence materially different from H1 2026 burn, invalidating the runway sensitivity.
Evidence that the cited transaction-cost liability had already been paid before the pro-forma cash reference date.
chiefActionDetail: Treat the point-in-time common-share and pre-funded-warrant unknowns as substantially resolved. Keep the broader directive open for legacy/rollover award reconciliation and primary post-close liquidity/runway evidence. Preserve the distinction between issued shares, common-equivalent warrants, reserved plan capacity and contingent earnouts.
